environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in shared VPC with IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/graphql-service-role. Role has s3:PutObject on audit bucket, lambda:InvokeFunction on *, and ec2:DescribeInstances. No permission boundary attached. Task has outbound internet access via NAT gateway. Node.js 18 runtime with vm2@3.9.17 (vulnerable to sandbox escape CVE-2023-37466).
